details: The existing independent rehasher selects v1/4.2.0 or v2/4.2.1 schemas and output identities, authenticating frozen historical CCC00 records separately from requested CCC01 output.

Independent row validation binds schema, kind, source version, authority source version and reconciled distribution version. Existing source, archive, metadata, receipt, engine, predecessor and log checks remain required.

Portable controls use constructed candidate rows and ZIPs with an explicit engine-lookup fixture. Both versions reach an intentional predecessor refusal; malformed rows with rebound upstream hashes are rejected before engine lookup. No accepted rehash output or native execution is produced.

Actual candidate-bound independent rehash, native qualification, engine and later release consumer acceptance remain outstanding. This input-contract change grants no support, signing, promotion, tagging or publication acceptance.
